title: Publish the game (build and deploy latest version)

requirements.text: Publish the game by building and deploying the latest version so the currently committed frontend and backend canisters are upgraded and the live URL serves the newest build.
acceptanceCriteria: A new deployment is performed for both frontend assets and the backend canister(s), upgrading to the latest source in the repository.
The live application loads without errors and reflects the latest deployed build (no stale cached bundle served).
Basic smoke-check passes on the live deployment: user can load the Dashboard route ('/'), navigate to Race Lobby ('/race'), and authentication via Internet Identity still works.

constraints: Do not introduce new product features or UI changes as part of the publish request; only build/deploy and verify the latest version is live.
nonGoals: Adding new gameplay mechanics, economy features, admin features, or design changes.
